# AMCP llms.txt

> AMCP (Agent Model Context Protocol) is the interoperability layer for the
> any-agent-to-any-agent economy. This index orients AI systems reading the
> repo. Wire-first: schemas + spec + fixtures + vectors are normative.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): status, install, quickstart, repo layout
- [VISION](VISION.md): thesis, eight locked primitives, consent control plane
- [Conformance](conformance/fixtures/README.md): how ports prove compatibility

## The eight primitives (lifecycle order)

- Identity + Capability: [descriptor schema](schemas/descriptor.schema.json),
  [spec overview](spec/overview.md)
- Intent: [spec/intents.md](spec/intents.md) (demand-side discovery)
- Authorization Chain: [spec/authorization.md](spec/authorization.md)
  (monotone delegation, fixed evaluation order)
- Commitment: [contract schema](schemas/contract.schema.json)
- Receipt: [receipt schema](schemas/receipt.schema.json) (settlement-bound proof)
- Evidence: [directory spec](spec/directory.md) (source-keyed, portable)
- Dispute: [disputes spec](spec/disputes.md) (claim/adjudicate/enforce)

## Cross-cutting

- Reputation v1 (pinned weights, weight-zero experiments): [spec/reputation.md](spec/reputation.md)
- Verification (executed acceptance): [spec/verification.md](spec/verification.md)
- Consent control plane: [VISION.md](VISION.md#8-consent-a-control-plane-not-a-step)
- Economy research deltas: [spec/economy.md](spec/economy.md)
- Sessions/keys/streaming/settlement/wire: [spec/](spec/overview.md)

## Implement

- Reference oracle (stdlib Python): [reference/agent.py](reference/agent.py)
- TypeScript SDK (`@amcp-protocol/sdk`, zero deps): [sdk-ts/](sdk-ts/README.md)
- Shared test vectors (money, reputation, delegation, verification):
  [conformance/vectors/](conformance/vectors/money.json)
- Examples (CI-validated): [examples/](examples/descriptor.minimal.json)
